title: Rammitle numma gorrisan
intro: dumaahi cayla kee baab baaxol, kaxxa bood yakke. Inki gammi qibaadah astootih reeda yabbixeeh, gersi gammi akke waytam ramaddossam gabbata. Xaloot aydaadi korsi amotani milaagele. atu ellecabo numma yubleeh, tohuk afal sinni rammitle marih kinnaane qaddossam duuddaa?
clues: Nanu nubleh astooti too gexxeh taturte baab cogdah
Nanu too astooti inki numma rabbik temeetem cedneh
Nanu qimbô ayyuntak sugne tannah yan diraamah gital imaan oggolak sugne
Nanu elle naamineh nan innal gannat xagnisneh sugne
Ni akatta kee coox ni intiitak afal baaxoh alluwwa yekke, uxih nanu xayyosnam doorne

trial.answer: yallih farmoyti muusah adoytit luk tekke garay

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
